## Safety and ownership

- [ ] Jamulus remains the live-audio owner.
- [ ] Webex remains the external meeting-state owner.
- [ ] Studio changes remain non-destructive.
- [ ] No credentials, invitations, meeting links, paths, or raw exceptions are
      added to logs, diagnostics, support bundles, or documentation.
- [ ] Physical, credentialed, signing, and notarization gates are labeled
      PASS, FAIL, or **NOT RUN** with exact evidence.

## Release impact

- [ ] No existing tag or immutable release asset changes.
- [ ] Changelog and canonical user/developer documentation are updated.
- [ ] If package or workflow identity changes, the release runbook is updated.
